title: 第019章 陈默出手第020章 马后炮
content_zh:
第019章陈默出手
“周豪这个小人，以后别说我认识他！”李强恐被周豪连累，见到周豪逃走，第一个跳出来跟周豪撇清关系。
“今天他周豪既然做出这种恶心事，以后这同学情，到此为止！”赵林也义愤填膺的怒喝。
“对，等开学了，一定要把周豪今天的所作所为，传遍全校，看他以后还怎么有脸在学校待下去！”其他同学也是怒不可遏，纷纷决定，跟周豪断绝关系。
打了周豪一巴掌，张虎稍感解气，不过，这并不能阻止他将要做的事，在这条街，他张虎的地位不容挑衅！
“兄弟们！”张虎的右手再次高高扬起，然后，迅速落下：“砸！”
十几名小弟马上行动，有的搬起椅子，有的直接拿出手里的钢管，对着餐馆里面的桌椅就是一通乱砸。
乒乒乓乓，咔嚓咔嚓，木屑纷飞，整个餐馆瞬间乱成一团。
所有同学慌忙站起身，聚在一起，躲在墙角的位置，深恐被波及到。
就连蒋瑶父母，也是面色惊恐的向后退，直到此刻，蒋瑶妈妈还不敢相信张虎居然真的敢砸她的餐馆。
只有蒋瑶，孤零零的站在原地，任由木屑纷飞，从她清秀的脸庞划过，始终没有后退半步。
这家餐馆，承载着她小小心灵中所有的梦想。她天性自卑，没有人知道她的自卑源自哪里？但是，她自己很清楚，她的自卑就是因为家世！
每次跟安可悦她们那些人站在一起，蒋瑶总是忘不了她的家世，感觉低人一等。她渴望改变，她希望有一天能够跟安可悦站在一起的时候，可以昂首挺胸！
“住手！”
蒋瑶突然爆发出一声怒吼，声音清脆，却带着一股即将赴死的悲壮。
可是，她的声音很快就被淹没在乱糟糟的打砸声中，如同一粒沙尘，投入苍茫大海。
蒋瑶脸上浮起一抹决然，淡淡笑着，如果自己死在他们棍棒下，或许，应该可以保住餐馆吧！
突然，蒋瑶毫无征兆的冲向距离她最近的一个青年钢管之下，只要五步，蒋瑶就能成功迎接那夺命的钢管。
可是，就在蒋瑶的脚步刚刚抬起，一只消瘦，却温柔有力的手，拉住了她。
回头，蒋瑶看到陈默正对着她露出淡淡的微笑：“让他们砸，放心，他们今天砸多少，我让他们十倍赔偿！”

“相信我！”
陈默的声音很轻，可是却带着强大到不容置疑的自信，感染着蒋瑶，蒋瑶竟然生不出一丝怀疑，选择毫无保留的信任陈默。
她相信陈默既然说得出，就绝对做的到！
“恩！我相信你，陈默哥！”瞬间，蒋瑶泪流满面。
前世，在少年最悲伤的时候，少女义无反顾的照料，不离不弃。
今世，在少女最无助的时候，少年毫不犹豫地伸出援助之手，暖其心灵！
“差不多了吧！”淡淡的声音，突然响起，却清晰传入所有人的耳中。
陈默把蒋瑶拉在身后，双手插进裤兜，缓缓走出，脸上带着一抹若有若无的笑意。
正在打砸的青年们瞬间一愣，不由自主的停手。
光头张虎好奇的盯着陈默，嘿嘿笑道：“你谁啊？活腻歪了，敢管我张虎的事？”
陈默面带微笑，稍微歪着头，玩味的看着张虎，淡淡道：“一个你惹不起的人！”
“我艹！”
张虎目瞪口呆，忍不住爆了句粗口，回头对着那帮小弟大笑道：“兄弟们，你们听到了没有？他说是我惹不起的人，你们说，在这条街，有我张虎惹不起的人吗？”
“哈哈……”
十几个小弟发出一阵哄笑，嘲讽的看着陈默，就像看一个小丑。
content_en:
Chapter 019 Chen Mo takes action
"Zhou Hao, this villain, don't say that I know him in the future!" Li Qiang was afraid of being implicated by Zhou Hao. When he saw Zhou Hao escaping, he was the first to jump out and break up with Zhou Hao.
"Since Zhou Hao did such a disgusting thing today, this friendship will end here!" Zhao Lin also shouted indignantly.
"Yes, when school starts, what Zhou Hao did today must be spread throughout the school to see how he will have the honor to stay in school in the future!" Other students were also furious and decided to cut off relations with Zhou Hao.
After slapping Zhou Hao, Zhang Hu felt a little relieved. However, this did not stop what he was about to do. In this street, Zhang Hu's status did not allow for provocation!
"Brothers!" Zhang Hu raised his right hand high again, and then quickly lowered it: "Smash!"
More than a dozen boys immediately took action. Some lifted chairs, while others took out the steel pipes in their hands and smashed them against the tables and chairs in the restaurant.
Ping-ping-pong-pong, rattling, sawdust flying, the whole restaurant instantly became a mess.
All the students stood up in a hurry, gathered together, and hid in the corner, fearing that they would be affected.
Even Jiang Yao's parents backed away with horrified expressions. Until this moment, Jiang Yao's mother still couldn't believe that Zhang Hu actually dared to smash her restaurant.
Only Jiang Yao stood alone, letting the sawdust fly across her delicate face, never taking a step back.
This restaurant carries all the dreams in her little heart. She has low self-esteem by nature. No one knows where her low self-esteem comes from. However, she knew very well that her inferiority complex was due to her family background!
Every time she stood with An Keyue and the others, Jiang Yao could not forget her family background and felt inferior. She longs for change, and she hopes that one day when she can stand with An Keyue, she can hold her head high!
"Stop!"
Jiang Yao suddenly burst out with a roar, his voice was clear and crisp, but it carried a tragic and solemn feeling that he was about to die.
However, her voice was soon drowned in the chaotic sound of smashing, like a grain of sand thrown into the vast sea.
A look of determination appeared on Jiang Yao's face, and she smiled lightly. If she died under their sticks, maybe she could keep the restaurant!
Suddenly, without warning, Jiang Yao rushed under the steel pipe of a young man who was nearest to her. In just five steps, Jiang Yao could successfully meet the fatal steel pipe.
However, just as Jiang Yao lifted her steps, a thin but gentle and strong hand held her.
Looking back, Jiang Yao saw Chen Mo smiling faintly at her: "Let them smash it, don't worry, I will let them compensate ten times as much as they smashed today!"
"Trust me!"
Chen Mo's voice was very soft, but it carried a strong and unquestionable self-confidence, which infected Jiang Yao. Jiang Yao didn't even have a trace of doubt, and chose to trust Chen Mo without reservation.
She believes that since Chen Mo can say it, he can definitely do it!
"Yes! I believe in you, Brother Chen Mo!" In an instant, Jiang Yao burst into tears.
In the previous life, when the boy was in his saddest time, the girl took care of him without hesitation and never left him.
In this world, when a girl is most helpless, a young man does not hesitate to lend a helping hand and warm her heart!
"It's almost done!" A faint voice suddenly sounded, but it was clearly heard in everyone's ears.
Chen Mo pulled Jiang Yao behind him, put his hands in his trouser pockets, and walked out slowly, with a faint smile on his face.
The young people who were smashing were stunned for a moment and stopped involuntarily.
The bald Zhang Hu stared at Chen Mo curiously, and said with a smile: "Who are you? You are so tired of living, how dare you interfere with my Zhang Hu's business?"
Chen Mo smiled, tilted his head slightly, looked at Zhang Hu playfully, and said lightly: "A person you can't afford to offend!"
"Fuck me!"
Zhang Hu was stunned and couldn't help but uttered a curse word. He turned around and laughed at the gang of boys: "Brothers, did you hear that? He said yesPeople I can’t afford to offend. Do you think there are people on this street that I, Zhang Hu, can’t afford to offend? "
"Haha..."
A dozen boys burst into laughter and looked at Chen Mo mockingly, like a clown.
